ordinary_worker_retry.name: G09 actual transient OPFS initialization failure permits fresh explicit open

limitations: ADR-0035 explicitly resolves original TC16.8: exact ordinary test-fixed-id-001 and surviving-command local:test-fixed-id-001 both pass; original wording remains historical.

Only one active OPFS worker per origin for fixed hoyadb-v1 pool, even different names. Owners share one runtime. A fresh explicit open can retry a failed pool initialization after the prior worker is terminated.
No mobile support claim, latency benchmark, browser heap measurement, WASM-total-process memory claim or numerical budget acceptance.
Project license/public distribution authorization remains unresolved; packages are private local artifacts.
Direct generated WASM declarations need ESNext.Disposable types; runtime uses free(), with no Symbol.dispose polyfill requirement.
Ordinary protection and functional cases use ordinary release artifact. File-byte inspection uses a separate default-off test-controls artifact; it is not shipped in the ordinary package.
